claim_boundary: This campaign can certify only the exact source-pinned BR13.0 canonical symmetry-collapsed quadruped profile, semantic prone/transition/stance observation, and successful phase-order scope; BR13.2 static work/reserve preflight and explicit post-trace actuator, contact-dissipation, guide-work, and energy-residual accounting scope; and BR13.4 digest-bound three-seed paired active-recovery and zero-command-control live Godot/Jolt scope. BR13.1 timeout, revocation, forbidden-contact, and exclusive-handoff checks and BR13.3 adversarial profile, scaffold, contact, claim, anatomy, seed, and guidance containment are integrity-only and cannot substitute for a milestone program. The BR13.4 analyzer boundary is verbatim: BR13 paired live Godot/Jolt recovery for one exact symmetry-collapsed quadruped laboratory profile. Each active seed begins in observed semantic ventral-contact prone, establishes ordinary front-pair and rear-pair distal support, raises measured whole-system center of mass with finite paired actuation, hands exclusively from the recovery controller to the stance controller, and completes the declared stance dwell. Each seed is compared with one same-state zero-command control that remains prone. Command receipts, transition-integrated actuator work, residual-inferred contact dissipation, and the material out-of-plane guide impulse/work boundary remain explicit. The positive conclusion is exactly constrained_planar_get_up for this fixture. It establishes no free-3D recovery, morphology transfer, gait, walking, repair, or automatic creature guidance. The material sagittal guide remains part of the experiment, each front or rear rigid strut represents a mirrored limb pair rather than independent left/right limbs, raw contact observations establish no per-foot load allocation, and no result generalizes beyond the exact source-pinned profile, actuator, thresholds, seed set, physics rate, or floor fixture.

programs.claim_scope: The exact symmetry-collapsed quadruped profile pins semantic ventral-contact prone, stable front-pair and rear-pair distal stance, the sagittal material guide, ordinary unilateral contacts, the three-seed set, and the matched zero-command requirement; the quadruped-specific observer preserves invalid or unavailable evidence as UNKNOWN; and the observation-only phase supervisor permits only the declared successful order while granting no force, torque, repair, or guidance authority.

Integrity-only phase supervision proves that missing observations time out with the named phase, energy or actuator-reserve revocation and forbidden contact fail immediately, duplicate ticks fail closed, stance handoff rejects overlapping recovery authority, and neither mutation nor automatic guidance can enter the supervisor; it cannot substitute for a live get-up milestone.

The recovery energy ledger seals mass-gravity-height work, torque, power, and structural reserve preflight and explicitly reconciles positive and absorbed actuator work, mechanical-energy change, residual-inferred contact dissipation, and residual-inferred guide work. Material positive guide work, unexplained energy residual, external-work substitution for actuator work, and insufficient reserves fail closed; feasible accounting grants no actuation or guidance authority.

Integrity-only containment preserves the verbatim bounded profile and rejects broader positive claims, morphology generalization, free-3D recovery, automatic guidance, missing controls, nonordinary contact authority, scaffold weakening, undeclared anatomy, forbidden head contact, duplicate seeds, hidden root rescue, and mutation authority; it cannot substitute for physical execution evidence.

A digest-bound campaign runs seeds 13001, 13002, and 13003 as paired active-recovery and same-state zero-command-control live Godot/Jolt worlds. Every active world begins in observed prone, uses finite paired actuator commands and complete execution receipts, establishes ordinary distal support, raises whole-system center of mass by at least 0.35 m, closes its transition-integrated energy ledger, preserves the material guide bounds, hands exclusively to stance control, and completes stable STANCE; every control remains PRONE with zero commands and work. Truncated phase order, forged walking, guide assistance, unclosed energy, overlapping handoff, control substitution, and post-seal mutation fail closed.
